arguments.title: Formspec ManagedSingleCell
arguments.brief: Manage one production-shaped forms cell, complete a public response, and inspect the proof and readiness states the active host actually returns.

statement.want: to create a managed form and return to its draft
statement.why: form work must remain usable without editing raw JSON
statement.done: the owner can create, find, and edit a stored form with ownership and version lineage

statement.want: to publish an immutable version and share its hosted link
statement.why: respondents need one stable version to complete
statement.done: publish returns a version and share URL without changing prior versions

statement.want: to publish changes without moving active responses to a different version
statement.why: the submitted and signed content must remain stable
statement.done: the owner sees immutable versions and can retire a version intentionally while active work stays pinned

statement.want: to find, inspect, and export collected responses
statement.why: the collected information must be usable outside raw storage
statement.done: the owner can view a response queue and request CSV, JSON, or response detail output

statement.want: a confirmation that points to the receipt
statement.why: people should not have to poll the dashboard or wonder whether intake succeeded
statement.done: the owner can request a deduplicated receipt email without embedding sensitive response content

statement.want: a clear result and a path to the receipt after submit
statement.why: the final step must confirm what happened without hiding proof state
statement.done: the post-submit view says the response was received and keeps the receipt reachable

statement.want: a stable PDF of the form or completed response
statement.why: portable filing and review still depend on fixed output
statement.done: the product offers form and response PDF actions tied to the exact version and response

statement.who: a respondent using a phone, keyboard, screen reader, or zoom
statement.want: to complete the public form without layout or control barriers
statement.why: public intake must work for the people it serves
statement.done: the public form uses labelled fields, clear controls, and narrow-screen-safe layout

statement.want: clear validation and a review step before submit
statement.why: errors and signature disclosures must be visible before commitment
statement.done: the respondent can correct fields, review answers, and choose the next action

statement.want: a receipt that shows what proof exists now
statement.why: a thank-you screen cannot settle a disputed submission
statement.done: the receipt distinguishes accepted, proof pending, proof ready, and proof failed and gives verification instructions when ready

statement.want: to make a response optionally require an attestation tied to its content
statement.why: a serious signature must bind intent to the response digest
statement.done: the owner can select signature mode and the signer can read the exact attestation

statement.want: to create an envelope and give a signer the right content
statement.why: signature work is an operational flow, not only a cryptographic primitive
statement.done: the coordinator can create an envelope and open the signer path for the preserved content

statement.want: to see signer state and request a reminder
statement.why: an invisible stalled envelope cannot be managed
statement.done: the signature view reports envelope state and exposes a reminder action

statement.want: a certificate that survives outside the live app
statement.why: signature proof must preserve attribution, digest, disclosures, and verification instructions
statement.done: the verification view reports certificate availability and offers the certificate only when materialized

statement.want: to verify that the response still matches the submitted bytes
statement.why: mutable dashboard state is not proof against tampering
statement.done: the verifier view reports canonical hashes, checkpoint references, verifier output, or the exact missing proof step

needs.title: Know whether the cell can accept work

statement.want: readiness signals for the active ManagedSingleCell dependencies
statement.why: a green process alone does not prove intake can work
statement.done: the readiness view shows each returned component status and adapter detail without upgrading test health into a production claim

statement.want: to load a version-pinned hosted form through the runtime endpoint or embed snippet
statement.why: published forms need a predictable distribution path outside the owner dashboard
statement.done: the published runtime returns the Definition, theme, locale, runtime settings, cache behavior, and stable embed reference

config.caption: Managed forms
config.emptyMessage: No managed forms are available from the active cell.

config.title: Choose the next form task
config.body: Actions use the active host; this bundle contains no form fixtures.

config.title: Signature work
config.body: Open the signature queue returned by the active host.

config.title: Form and version
config.body: Published versions stay immutable; the host supplies the current form and version.

config.title: Published version
config.body: Retiring a version does not rewrite responses or signature envelopes already pinned to it.

config.caption: Responses from the active cell
config.emptyMessage: No accepted responses are available from the active cell.

config.title: Inspect or export
config.body: Exports come from host actions and never from invented widget rows.

config.title: Accepted response
config.body: Accepted intake and verifier-backed proof are separate states.

config.title: Responses available for signature
config.body: Create an envelope only for a response that exposes a signed payload digest.

config.title: Active cell readiness
config.body: These values describe the active profile and adapters. They do not certify a production deployment, backup, or restore.

config.title: Review before submitting
config.body: Required fields and errors remain visible before the review step.

config.title: Check your response
config.body: Submit now or review the optional signature statement. No signature is implied by this review page.

config.lead: Read this statement before the host asks you to sign.
config.statement: I confirm that the response I reviewed is accurate and that this signature applies to that exact response digest.
config.acknowledgement: The host records the signing act; this frame only shows the statement.

config.title: Complete the host signing step
config.body: Completion is accepted separately from certificate materialization.

config.title: Signature certificate
config.body: Availability and verification claims come from the certificate service.

config.title: Keep or verify this receipt
config.body: Received does not mean independently verified. The proof state returned by the receipt service controls that claim.

config.title: Proof returned by the verifier path
config.body: This view reports stored proof material and missing steps; it does not infer proof from dashboard status.
